sampling: Nearest 20 m cell, row-major. Transform maps pixel corners in EPSG:32645. Lookup: project longitude/latitude; column=floor((x-transform[2])/20), row=floor((transform[5]-y)/20). Outside site bounds or grid returns null.
mask: Only SCL 4/5/6; no data, saturated, dark, cloud shadow, unclassified, cloud, cirrus and snow are null. Negative reflectance and nonpositive denominators are null.
